title: Hard-coded secret and high-entropy credential detection
attackSurface: Source text scanned for committed credentials before publication or deployment

hostile.title: High-entropy API key assignment
hostile.why: A generated high-entropy value assigned to an API key represents committed credential material without containing a real secret

hostile.title: High-entropy secret assignment
hostile.why: A generated high-entropy value assigned to a secret field represents a committed application secret

hostile.title: High-entropy token assignment
hostile.why: A generated high-entropy access-token assignment represents token material in source control

hostile.title: High-entropy password assignment
hostile.why: A generated high-entropy password assignment represents committed password material

hostile.title: Database URI password
hostile.why: A database connection string with embedded password material exposes the credential and the service location

hostile.title: JWT-shaped configuration value
hostile.why: A JWT-shaped configuration value often represents a bearer token committed to source

hostile.title: Private-key block shape
hostile.why: A generated private-key-shaped block represents asymmetric key material without containing a real key

hostile.title: Unlabelled high-entropy token
hostile.why: Even unlabelled high-entropy values can be credentials and need review

benign.title: Explicit example placeholder
benign.why: A conventional all-caps example placeholder carries no credential material

benign.title: Template placeholder
benign.why: A template placeholder is documentation rather than a live token

benign.title: Change-me placeholder
benign.why: A low-value placeholder that cannot authenticate to a real service

benign.title: Database URI without password
benign.why: A connection string without embedded password material

benign.title: Rotation documentation
benign.input: documentation = "tokens are rotated outside source control"
benign.why: Security documentation that mentions tokens is not itself a credential

benign.title: Empty secret field
benign.why: An empty configuration field contains no credential material

benign.title: Alphabet constant
benign.why: A deterministic alphabet constant is public source code

benign.title: Redacted placeholder
benign.why: A redacted placeholder explicitly indicates removed content
